top_signal.title: What’s one part of running your small business you wish you could automate?
top_signal.summary: I’ve been thinking about how much time small business owners spend on things that aren’t really the core of the business.   Not just creating content, but the ongoing stuff:     Checking website performance   Finding SEO issues   Watching what competitors are doing   Figuring out what needs attention   Keeping up with Google changes   Deciding what to work on next     AI can generate a lot of things now, but I’m more interested in using it for the  ongoing work after something is created .   For example, instead of AI building a website and stopping there, it could keep checking the site, identify problems, and help decide what should be improved next.   For those running a small business, what repetitive task takes up more of your time than it should?   And if you could automate one part of it, what would it be?       submitted by     /u/nasiruddinniad       [link]       [comments]
